inspection_method: ILSpy 9.1.0.7988 decompilation of selected types; original generator executed separately for deterministic comparison only.
maximum: Manual maximum wins; otherwise nominal * FloatingRatioPercent / 100. Percentage must be >= 100. Missing ratio requires manual input.
distribution: Average six random values for centered weights; replace 1-2 reserved positions near the high 5% edge, then 1-2 near the low 5% edge; replace 2-3 remaining positions with a repeated middle candidate. Cap position counts by available slots.
precision: Original one-decimal AwayFromZero rounding; builder rejects values outside the requested bounds. Added clamping has been removed.
timestamps: Original fixed generatedAt date for every row; one-second time increments. Added date rollover correction removed.
correction_to_old_ui_text: The old UI description nominal + allowed shortage contradicts the actual builder. Actual maximum derives from floating ratio, not shortage.
